name: com.mylatinlife/data
title: MyLatinLife Data
description: Verified Latin America data: residency, citizenship, tax, safety, passports, clubs and events.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Quick coverage catalog of countries and trade blocs: ISO code, region, headline and available data topics. For one country's facts, call get_country_profile; this tool does not return visa or index details.

tools.name: find_visas
tools.description: Filter the digital-nomad, retirement (pensionado) and investor visa datasets by entry minimum, type, region, presence and citizenship time; results sort by lowest minimum within each type. This is the numeric filter for those three visa families. For natural-language search across the broader residency and citizenship catalog, use search_programs; for one selected program's full sourced record, use get_program.

visa_type.description: Visa category to search. Defaults to "any".

max_minimum_usd.description: Only visas whose entry minimum is at or below this.

region.description: A region ("South America", "Central America", "North America", "Caribbean", "Europe") or "Latin America".

countries.description: Only these countries. Country names or slugs, e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"].

max_years_to_citizenship.description: Only visas with a path to citizenship of at most this many years of residency (the program's own figure, or for a digital nomad visa that counts toward permanent residency, the country's naturalization rule). Visas with no known path drop out.

max_presence.description: Only visas whose stay requirement to keep the residency is at most this: visits_only (occasional visits, a few days a year or less), part_year (regular stays, up to about 3 months a year or re-entry every 6 months), most_of_year. Visas without a rating, including digital nomad visas, drop out.

passive_investment.description: true: only investor visas that accept a passive investment (no business to run). Other visa types drop out.

limit.description: How many visas to return, cheapest first within each type. Defaults to 25; count gives the total, so narrow with the filters above.

tools.name: get_country_profile
tools.description: One-country roll-up: a summary plus the available visa, citizenship, tax, banking, property-tax, cost-of-living, safety, healthcare, passport, expat-index and blacklist data. Pass topics to limit the response because a full profile can be large. Use compare_countries for the same topic across countries, or get_program for one immigration program's complete sourced record.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

topics.description: Only return these topics. Omit for the full profile.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Full record for one named or selected residency, visa or citizenship program. Returns a canonical summary plus sourced requirements, income or investment minimum, stay rules, permanent-residency and citizenship timelines, government fees, processing time, legal basis and verification dates. Use search_programs or find_visas to identify a program first; pass its program_id for the most precise match.

program.description: A program_id such as "panama-friendly-nations-visa", or part of a program name such as "Paraguay investor".

tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Free-text search across the full immigration catalog, including visas, residency-to-permanent-residency and citizenship pathways. Natural-language aliases such as "golden visa", "property residency", "pension visa" and "remote work visa" are recognized. Returns compact matches with reasons and program_ids; call get_program for one match's complete sourced record. For numeric minimum and presence filters on the three visa families, use find_visas.

query.description: Optional words to find across program names and details, e.g. "property investment", "pension" or "naturalization".

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

program_type.description: Only this program category. Defaults to "any".

limit.description: How many matching programs to return. Defaults to 25; count gives the total.

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Compare two or more countries on one available dataset topic, such as tax_systems, banking or cost_of_living. Returns the matching source rows side by side; use a specialized compare tool for passport, crypto, freedom or city-safety rankings.

countries.description: Two or more countries to compare. Country names or slugs, e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"].

topic.description: The topic to compare on. Dataset topic, e.g. "tax_systems", "digital_nomad_visas" or "cost_of_living".

tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: Compare 2–8 immigration programs, including programs from different countries. Returns a compact side-by-side view of minimum income or investment, citizenship time, stay requirement, processing time, government fee, tax context and links. Find candidates with search_programs or find_visas, then pass their program_ids or names.

programs.description: Program IDs such as "panama-qualified-investor", or names such as "Paraguay investor".

tools.name: get_settlement_blocs
tools.description: Cross-border residence rights based on nationality under the MERCOSUR Residence Agreement, Andean Migratory Statute and CARICOM free movement. Returns conditions, permanent-residency timelines, legal sources and eligible passports. Pass a country to see which agreements its citizens may use; these are regional agreements, not individual visa programs.

bloc.description: One agreement. Omit for all of them.

country.description: A nationality: which agreements its citizens can use. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

tools.name: find_private_clubs
tools.description: Search the sourced club directory for country, city, yacht and hybrid clubs. Returns membership/access notes, reciprocity, facilities, official links, sources and verification dates. Use club_type=golf to find directory clubs whose verified facilities mention golf. This is club discovery, not a golf-course ranking; use find_golf_courses for the ranked course shortlist. "Unknown" network status does not mean "not listed."

country.description: Only clubs in this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

city.description: Only clubs whose city contains these words, e.g. "Bogota".

club_type.description: Only this club type; golf matches clubs whose verified facilities mention golf.

query.description: Words to match in the club name, city, facilities or notes.

limit.description: How many clubs to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: find_golf_courses
tools.description: Search MyLatinLife's 40-course editorial ranking by country, city, access category or words. Results stay in published rank order and include the rationale, access notes and sources. Phone, email, contact-page and booking fields appear only when verified. Use find_private_clubs for the broader club directory. This endpoint is neither a complete course inventory nor a live tee-time service or objective course rating.

country.description: Only courses in this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

city.description: Only courses whose city or region contains these words.

access_type.description: Filter by the access category stated in the current course record; confirm the venue's current rules.

query.description: Words to match in the course name, location, rationale or access notes.

contact_only.description: Return only records with a verified phone, email, contact page or booking URL.

limit.description: How many ranked courses to return. Defaults to 40.

tools.name: compare_passports
tools.description: Compare the published passport-power index for selected countries, including visa-free access, US ESTA eligibility, regional settlement rights and MyLatinLife's score. Omit countries for the full ranking; use compare_countries with topic=passport_power for the underlying country rows.

countries.description: Countries to compare; omit for the full ranking. Country names or slugs, e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"].

tools.name: check_military_service
tools.description: Country-level military-service and conscription exposure, including considerations for an adult who naturalizes and for their children, with the governing sources. This is a country research summary, not an individual legal determination.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

tools.name: find_firearm_rules
tools.description: Country-level summary of firearm ownership and carry rules relevant to foreign residents, including minimum age, regulator, cited law and sources. It does not determine an individual permit application or authorize possession.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

tools.name: compare_crypto_adoption
tools.description: Compare two separate views of crypto by country: grassroots adoption and investor mobility. Their scores and methods remain separate; do not treat the investor assessment as a measure of everyday use.

countries.description: Countries to compare; omit for the full index. Country names or slugs, e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"].

tools.name: compare_freedom
tools.description: Compare human, personal and economic freedom scores and global ranks, including countries that were not rated.

countries.description: Countries to compare; omit for the full index. Country names or slugs, e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"].

tools.name: compare_city_safety
tools.description: Search MyLatinLife's city Safety Index by country or city. City scores start with the country index plus documented city adjustments; they are comparative editorial estimates, not real-time crime data or a neighborhood-level guarantee.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

tools.name: find_renunciation_rules
tools.description: Country rules on whether a citizen by birth can renounce nationality, with legal basis and any distinction for naturalized citizens. This is separate from citizenship-by-descent eligibility and does not submit a renunciation application.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

tools.name: find_sovereignty_projects
tools.description: Search a directory of charter cities, special economic zones, micronations, network states and related sovereignty experiments. Filter by words, region, project status or category; the directory does not imply legal sovereignty or government recognition.

query.description: Words to match across name, host, location and description.

tools.name: find_nomad_events
tools.description: Search the dated event calendar for digital-nomad conferences, festivals, cruises, workations and related events. Use date filters to find events within a period; check the organizer source for current schedules and availability.

query.description: Words to match across title and location.

date_from.description: Events ending on or after YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Events starting on or before YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: check_citizenship_by_descent
tools.description: Screen one country for possible citizenship eligibility through a parent, grandparent or great-grandparent. Returns the generation rule, likely timeline, difficulty, document pointers and country guide. This is an initial screen, not a legal determination; ancestry facts and records still need review.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

tools.name: calculate_residency_return
tools.description: Calculate a conservative return-by date from the last day in country under the supported Panama and Paraguay residency-maintenance rules. The calculation uses the day before the calendar anniversary. It is limited to the listed residency types; it does not calculate presence for other countries or citizenship.

departure_date.description: Last day in the country, YYYY-MM-DD.

as_of.description: Optional date for the countdown, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

tools.name: count_travel_days
tools.description: Count inclusive calendar days per country and calendar year, deduplicate overlapping trips, and report each country's maximum in any rolling 365-day window. Use this general travel log for country-presence tracking; use calculate_feie_days for the US tax test. Each entry is Country|arrival|departure.

entries.description: Trips as Country|YYYY-MM-DD|YYYY-MM-DD; arrival and departure both count.

limit.description: Your comparison threshold in days. Defaults to 183.

tools.name: calculate_feie_days
tools.description: Apply the US Foreign Earned Income Exclusion physical-presence day-count method to travel entries, including the best rolling 12-month window. This is the tax-specific calculation, not the general by-country travel summary in count_travel_days. Each entry is arrival|departure|type, where type is us, other or transit; transit under 24 hours counts zero.

tools.name: estimate_tax_savings
tools.description: Run the same simplified effective-rate scenario as the website Tax Savings Calculator for selected origin, income, subdivision and income type. This is a directional model, not a tax-return calculation; it omits deductions, credits, sourcing, payroll/self-employment tax, treaties, destination-country tax and individual facts.

income.description: Annual income in the model currency, from 30,000 to 1,000,000.

subdivision.description: US state or Canadian province from the model; omit for the default rate curve.

income_type.description: Income type. FEIE is modeled only for US employment or freelance income.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Bulk export of every row in one dataset, optionally limited to one country. Use this to import a topic into a product or workflow, not to look up one answer; ordinary search and comparison tools return complete results without a key. Bulk exports require a commercial API key: https://mylatinlife.com/api/v1/plan?src=tools

country.description: Only rows for this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Dated change log for tracked datasets, newest first. Includes changed program facts (with old and new values), tax-list additions/removals and changes in what MyLatinLife covers. Dates show when MLL recorded a dataset change, not when a law took effect or a government announced a policy.

country.description: Only changes for this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

topic.description: Only changes in this topic. Dataset topic, e.g. "tax_systems", "digital_nomad_visas" or "cost_of_living".

since.description: Only changes recorded on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

kind.description: Only this kind of change. "changed" is a value that changed; the coverage kinds track what MyLatinLife covers.

limit.description: How many changes to return, newest first. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: Retrieve recently published MyLatinLife articles and guides, newest first, with URL, dates and excerpt. Optionally match words in the title. This searches MLL content; it is not a news search across the web.

query.description: Words the article title must contain, e.g. "Panama" or "Paraguay residency". Omit for the newest articles overall.

limit.description: How many articles to return. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: find_mll_service
tools.description: Find a MyLatinLife service when someone wants help handling a residency, citizenship, banking, tax, document or company application. Returns service name, page and whether it starts online or with a consultation call; it does not return prices. Filter by country, service-name words or both.

country.description: Only services for this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

query.description: Words the service name must contain, e.g. "residency", "bank account", "citizenship" or "US tax".

tools.name: find_videos
tools.description: Find videos from MyLatinLife's YouTube catalog, newest first, about residency, citizenship, banking, tax, cost of living and life in Latin America. Optionally filter by country or words in the title; this searches MLL's channel, not all YouTube.

country.description: Only videos about this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

query.description: Words the video title must contain, e.g. "retire" or "bank account".

limit.description: How many videos to return. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: about_data
tools.description: API orientation: dataset names, descriptions, row counts, verification-date ranges, country coverage, change-log start date, usage terms and citation instructions. Use this first to see whether the API contains the topic you need.

tools.name: check_tax_blacklists
tools.description: Check whether a country or jurisdiction appears on tracked tax and AML blacklists or greylists, including EU Annex I/II, OECD, FATF and selected national lists. Returns list status, dates, legal basis and stated consequences; this is distinct from the separate FATF greylist taxonomy.

jurisdiction.description: Name or ISO alpha-2 code, e.g. "PA".
